text:
Aria (PM): Quick design check for evals diff panel. Goals: make regressions discoverable in the compact list, clarify the "Set baseline" CTA, and ensure keyboard + SR flow for the run scrubber. Mock: https://img.redwood.company/ux/evals-diff-compact.png

Noah (Design): Main asks: add a tiny legend (+ colorblind patterns), stronger regression affordance (not just a dot), and clearer modal microcopy. I sketched a collapsible legend and a left baseline marker.

Sophie (Frontend): Collapsible legend is fine outside the virtualized list. For keyboard users, hover-only reveals won't work; expose a toggle (Enter) to expand metadata. Hotkeys proposal: ArrowRight/ArrowLeft for next/prev regression, and 'B' to open the baseline modal.

Marco (UX Research): In quick sessions participants confused "Snapshot" vs "Set baseline". Tested microcopy: "Set current outputs as baseline. Future runs will be compared against these outputs. You can revert from baseline history." scored highest. Also they liked an undo toast after action.

Noah (Design): Modal copy candidates (short):
1) "Set current outputs as the baseline for this prompt set. Future runs will compare against these outputs."
2) "Confirm: Make these outputs the new baseline. View or revert in baseline history."
3) "Make outputs baseline (recommended for release)."

Aria (PM): Vote with emoji. I'm leaning to 2) because it mentions revert.

Sophie (Frontend): +1 on 2). Implementation notes: modal should have role="dialog" and the confirm button text should read "Set baseline" (not just "Confirm") so SR announces intent. We'll implement a 10s undo toast calling the revert endpoint.

a11y-bot: Accessibility findings: regression badge contrast fails in dense mode (AA). Recommend alternate tokens: light theme badge text #0F4A72 on #EAF8FF or add a 2px outline. For patterns use SVG background-image for colorblind support. Scrubber must use role="slider" and support Arrow keys, Home/End; announce changes via aria-live: e.g., "Run 8: 2 regressions, medium density." Ensure toast has role="status" and its "Undo" button is focusable.

Noah (Design): I'll update the mock with the legend, pattern badges, left baseline marker, and modal copy 2). Also add the undo toast state in the success flow.

Sophie (Frontend): Action items:
- Prototype keyboard nav + aria-live demo (ETA Tue).
- Lazy-render the metadata panel on focus to avoid perf hit.

Marco (UX Research): I'll run 5 quick confirmatory tests on the updated mock after Noah posts.

Aria (PM): Owners + deadlines: Noah - mock update Wed EOD; Sophie - prototype next Tue; Marco - tests after mock. Sync Fri 9am PT to sign off. If you can't make it, drop :raised_hand: here.
